name: Pasta Salad with Chicken
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Carrots, peeled and sliced thin or shredded
Canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed
Canned green peas, drained and rinsed
Canned sweet corn, drained and rinsed

steps: Peel the cucumber and cut in half. Scoop out the seeds and discard them. Dice the cucumber.
Combine the cucumber and carrots. Add the drained pasta, kidney beans, peas, corn, baked beans, eggs, and chicken. Toss to mix.
Mix in ranch dressing, mayonnaise, and ketchup to taste.
Allow to chill a few hours before serving.
